headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Environmental Protection Agency if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: This order lists which EPA officials would step in to act as head of the agency if the Administrator and Deputy Administrator die, resign, or cannot do the job. It sets the order in which those officials would take over. No summary was provided, so details such as which specific positions are on the list are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Environmental Protection Agency
who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are named, in a set order, to temporarily take over the agency's top job if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 21, 2012; executive orders of this kind usually take effect when signed.
